title: PBCS Functional Consultant - Immediate Hiring - Mastek
description:
Please find the job description for the role of Oracle PBCS Functional Consultant. 
 Job Title: Oracle PBCS Functional Consultant Experience: 5+ years of relevant experience in Oracle PBCS / EPM Cloud or Hyperion Planning Company: Mastek Limited Location: Ahmedabad/Mumbai/Noida/Chennai/Trichy/Hyderabad (Hybrid) Shift : UK/US Shift 
 About Us 
 Mastek Limited is a trusted digital engineering and cloud transformation partner for enterprises across the globe. The company focuses on delivering business value through technology, combining deep domain expertise with modern engineering practices. Teams at Mastek collaborate in an inclusive environment that values integrity, learning, and innovation. Mastek is committed to building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture where every individual is respected, supported, and empowered to contribute. Candidates from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. 
 Job Summary 
 Mastek is seeking a proficient Oracle PBCS Functional Consultant to join the Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) practice. The consultant will be responsible for designing, configuring, and supporting Oracle Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service (PBCS) solutions for enterprise clients, primarily in the finance domain. The role involves working closely with finance stakeholders to understand budgeting, forecasting, and reporting requirements, translating them into scalable Oracle PBCS solutions, and ensuring smooth implementation and adoption. This position is ideal for a finance professional (CA or MBA Finance) with hands-on Oracle PBCS experience and a strong interest in technology-enabled performance management. 
 Key Responsibilities 
Solution Design & Implementation Collaborate with business and finance stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document planning, budgeting, and forecasting requirements. Design end-to-end Oracle PBCS solutions, including data models, forms, business rules, calculations, and workflows. Configure PBCS applications (modules, dimensions, hierarchies, security, and metadata) in line with best practices. Develop and maintain input forms, dashboards, reports, and task lists to support planning and reporting processes. Participate in full project lifecycle activities: requirement analysis, solution design, build, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. Functional & Process Expertise
 Map existing financial planning and budgeting processes to Oracle PBCS capabilities and recommend process improvements. Design and implement driver-based planning models, rolling forecasts, and scenario planning. Work with finance teams to align PBCS solutions with corporate budgeting, management reporting, and financial consolidation processes. Provide functional guidance on integration with upstream and downstream systems (ERP, data warehouses, reporting tools). Configuration, Testing & Documentation
 Configure business rules, calculations, allocations, and validations within PBCS. Support data integration and data management activities, including data loads, mappings, and validation. Develop and execute test scenarios and test scripts for unit testing, system integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Prepare functional design documents, configuration documents, user guides, and training materials. Stakeholder Management & Support
 Serve as a primary functional point of contact for clients on Oracle PBCS-related topics. Conduct user training sessions and workshops to drive solution adoption. Provide ongoing production support, troubleshooting issues, and implementing enhancements. Collaborate with technical teams, project managers, and other consultants to ensure timely and quality delivery. Governance & Continuous Improvement
 Adhere to project governance, documentation standards, and change management processes. Stay current with Oracle EPM Cloud / PBCS updates, new features, and industry best practices. Recommend continuous improvements to existing PBCS implementations to enhance performance, usability, and value. 
 Qualifications 5+ years of overall experience, with at least 3 years of hands-on experience as an Oracle PBCS / EPM Cloud / Hyperion Planning functional consultant. Proven experience in: Designing and implementing Oracle PBCS planning applications. Building and managing dimensions, metadata, and data forms. Creating and maintaining business rules, calculations, and allocations. Supporting budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting processes. Proficient understanding of: Financial planning and analysis (FP&A) concepts such as budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and scenario planning. Income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, and key financial metrics. Experience in data integration and data management within PBCS (e.g., Data Management / Data Management integrations, flat file loads, ERP integrations). Skilled in working with stakeholders from finance and IT, translating business requirements into functional solutions. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills. Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work independently and as part of a distributed team. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with other Oracle EPM Cloud modules (e.g., EPBCS, FCCS, ARCS, PCMCS) or on-premises Hyperion applications. Oracle EPM Cloud / PBCS-related certifications. Experience with Oracle ERP (E-Business Suite, Oracle Cloud ERP) or other ERP systems. Exposure to scripting or automation in the EPM context (e.g., Groovy, calculation scripts, EPM Automate). Experience working in consulting environments or on multi-country / global implementations.

Key Skills: PBCS,Epbcs,Hyperion Planning,Hyperion,Oracle EPM,EPM,Planning,Consulting

 About the Role We are looking for a proactive and organized service coordinator to support our branch service operations. The role will involve coordinating with service engineers, customers, the area service manager, the head office, finance, stores, and other internal teams to ensure smooth execution of service-related activities. 
 The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, strong follow-up ability, basic MS Office knowledge, and the ability to manage multiple administrative and service-coordination activities effectively. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Service & Payment Coordination 
 Follow up on outstanding service payments across AMC, Trading, Repair, Upgradation, and other service-related activities , including advance, due, and balance payments. Follow up on payments against both tax invoices and proforma invoices. Coordinate with customers and internal teams to ensure timely collection and closure of outstanding payments. Maintain proper records and follow-up trackers for pending payments. 
 2. Service Reporting & Documentation 
 Prepare and submit weekly service analysis reports to the Area Service Manager and Head Office. Maintain and share reports related to monthly revenue, expenditure, and collection . Ensure timely submission of service-related documents, including:
 Service Reports Installation Reports Customer Feedback Forms Vouchers Other relevant service documents Coordinate with service engineers to ensure proper documentation and timely submission. 
 3. Service Call & ERP Coordination 
 Monitor and maintain service call records in the IERP system , including:
 Call logging Call closing Service report uploading Status updates Follow up with service engineers for timely closure and documentation of service calls. Maintain the monthly complaint log of service engineers and submit the required report to HR. 
 4. Customer Coordination 
 Handle customer queries and service-related inquiries through telephone and email . Coordinate with customers and concerned service engineers for timely resolution of queries. Maintain professional communication and ensure timely follow-up on customer requirements. Coordinate for acknowledgement of spare parts/materials delivered through service engineers. 
 5. Spares & Gate Entry Coordination 
 Ensure that all spares/materials delivered through Service Engineers are properly acknowledged by the customer. Coordinate and collect required documentation such as delivery reports and gate entry details . Ensure proper records are maintained and submitted to the concerned department/head office. 
 6. Branch Administration 
 Maintain branch office attendance records and submit weekly attendance reports to Head Office. Coordinate routine administrative activities of the branch office. Coordinate housekeeping activities and ensure cleanliness and proper upkeep of the office/store area. Handle submission and coordination of various office utility bills and administrative documents with the Head Office. Maintain required attendance and administrative records of in-house staff. 
 7. Petty Cash & Courier Management 
 Handle branch-level petty cash and maintain proper records, supporting documents, and vouchers. Coordinate all incoming and outgoing courier activities. Maintain courier records and ensure timely dispatch and receipt of documents/materials. 
 8. Call Handling & Communication 
 Attend incoming and outgoing calls professionally. Direct calls to the concerned person, department, or extension. Maintain required call/communication records. Coordinate internal and external communication as required for smooth branch operations. 
 9. Inventory & Stock Coordination 
 Maintain proper stock records for the branch/store. Monitor stock movement and ensure records are updated regularly. Coordinate with the Stores Department regarding stock availability, movement, and requirements. Ensure proper documentation of material movement. Required Skills & Competencies 12 years of experience in service coordination / back office / branch administration / customer coordination / service operations. Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Basic knowledge of MS Office, Excel, and email communication . Ability to maintain reports, trackers, and documentation accurately. Good organizational and multitasking abilities. Customer-oriented approach with professional communication skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with Service Engineers and internal departments. Basic understanding of invoices, payments, and collection follow-up will be an advantage. Candidates from service-oriented, engineering, equipment, manufacturing, or technical organizations will be preferred. 
 Key Deliverables 
 Timely collection/payment follow-up. Accurate and timely weekly/monthly reporting. Proper service documentation and ERP updates. Effective coordination with Service Engineers and customers. Accurate branch attendance, petty cash, courier and administrative records. Proper stock and spare-part documentation. Timely escalation and closure of customer/service-related issues.

About Lowe s Lowe s is a FORTUNE 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com. Lowe s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India About the Team The Inventory Replenishment & Planning team ensures the right product, in the right quantity, in the right location, at the right time. It all starts with accurate sales forecasting. The Demand Planning team provides this forecast by analyzing trends and market intelligence, which guides inventory ordering and replenishment. title: Channel Partner Manager
description:
About the Company BPL Medical Technologies is a leading Indian medical technology company committed to advancing healthcare through innovative, reliable, and accessible solutions. With a strong legacy and nationwide presence, BPL serves hospitals, clinics, and healthcare providers across India and select international markets. The company offers a diverse portfolio across patient monitoring, imaging, and critical care, supported by robust manufacturing, service, and distribution capabilities. With a growing installed base and a focus on quality and customer trust, BPL continues to strengthen its position as a trusted partner in healthcare delivery. Driven by innovation and operational excellence, BPL is focused on building future-ready capabilities and delivering long-term value to customers, partners, and stakeholders. Get to know about us - https://www.bplmedicaltechnologies.com/ Role Summary A Channel Partner Manager is responsible for dealer engagement across the market. You'll establish and maintain relationships with dealers/channel partners to promote BPL's business, provide guidance, training, and support to dealers on our products, track dealer metrics and performance, and resolve dealer grievances and issues while ensuring new and existing dealers meet company guidelines on manpower, infrastructure, credit limits, and adherence to company policies and processes. Key Responsibilities Dealer Relationship Management & Business Development Drive business plan and sales strategy for the market to ensure attainment of company sales goals. Build and maintain strong relationships with the dealer base, interfacing directly with all dealer personnel. Provide timely support to help dealers win opportunities. Research and identify potential open markets and drive dealers to perform across their given area. Coordinate with internal team members on support required by dealers. Manage market study analysis to determine optimum dealer count and preferred locations; review and recommend markets, prospects, and product range for expanding dealer operations. Coordinate with Sales Field Operations on dealer improvement and/or replacement of poor-performing dealers. Training & Compliance Train and consult all dealer personnel to ensure a thorough understanding of products, policies, and procedures. Ensure company policies, procedures, and business ethics codes are communicated and implemented within the dealer network. Performance Management & Reporting Manage dealer performance in coordination with Sales Field Operations, including performance assessment, monitoring, and reporting. Provide regular updates on target vs. achievement, segment performance, and budget achievement; coordinate market intelligence and data input. Make regular presentations to management on dealer performance, flagging issues as needed. Documentation & Onboarding Manage CRM support and ISO-relevant process documentation for dealership management. Handle Letters of Intent, Dealer Agreements, and dealer onboarding for new dealers and renewals. What We’re Looking For Qualifications & Experience Technical/Science UG + PG (MBA). 7-10 years of relevant experience with dealer management exposure. Skills & Competencies Strong sales background and dealer operations experience. Excellent communication skills, written and verbal. Experience training personnel. Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills. Ability to work independently, with sound, independent judgement. Strong sales ability to expand footprint in the market by onboarding new dealers. Knowledge of the local markets. Willingness to travel extensively. Why This Role Matters You'll be at the front line of BPL's channel business — shaping how a leading medical technology company reaches customers across Diagnostic Cardiology, Imaging, and Critical Care, gaining: Direct ownership of dealer relationships and performance across your market. The opportunity to build and expand BPL's channel footprint by identifying and onboarding new dealers. Broad exposure to sales strategy, training, compliance, and dealer operations in a single role. The chance to work in a company with real purpose — where stronger dealer partnerships translate directly into wider access to healthcare, aligned to our purpose of Help Save Lives. Location – Bangalore/ Hyderabad/ Chennai

title: Customer Relationship Manager

For over two decades, Matrix has partnered with enterprises across IT/ITES, BFSI, Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare, Telecom, Logistics, and other sectors, delivering solutions spanning Background Verification, Due Diligence, Business Intelligence, Credentialing, Audit & Assurance, Fraud Risk Management, and Compliance Services. Background Verification is one of Matrixs flagship service offerings. Matrix screens over 576,000 candidates annually and works with 700 organizations, combining deep domain expertise, technology, and structured verification processes to help organizations reduce hiring risk and build trusted workforces. The Role We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Customer Relationship Manager to build and strengthen enterprise relationships, drive account growth, and generate new business opportunities for Matrix. The ideal candidate will bring strong industry relationships, relevant Background Verification experience, and a proven ability to convert market connects into tangible business. This is a relationship-led, revenue-focused role for someone who understands the BGV ecosystem, knows the key decision-makers, and can leverage an established network to open doors, create opportunities, and grow Matrix’s client base. Key Responsibilities 1. Client Relationship & Business Growth Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective enterprise clients. Leverage industry relationships and professional networks to generate qualified business opportunities. Identify opportunities for account expansion, cross-selling, upselling, and long-term revenue growth. Act as a trusted advisor to clients by understanding their workforce screening and risk-management requirements. 2. New Business Development Identify, prospect, and acquire new clients across target industries and enterprise segments. Develop and manage a healthy pipeline through referrals, industry connects, networking, market mapping, and proactive outreach. Own the sales cycle from initial introduction and discovery through proposal, negotiation, closure, and handover. Drive business development across Matrix’s Background Verification and related business assurance solutions. 3. Consultative Selling & Solutioning Understand client requirements around employee screening, onboarding, compliance, risk, and workforce verification. Position Matrix’s solutions through consultative, value-based selling and develop relevant business cases. Lead client meetings, presentations, solution discussions, proposals, and commercial negotiations. Coordinate with internal teams to develop solutions that meet client requirements and service expectations. 4. Account Management & Stakeholder Engagement Engage senior stakeholders including CHROs, HR Heads, Talent Acquisition Leaders, Compliance Heads, Procurement teams, and CXO-level decision-makers. Build multi-level relationships within key accounts to strengthen client engagement and retention. Ensure smooth transition of new accounts and work closely with delivery teams to support a strong client experience. Capture customer and market insights and share relevant feedback with internal stakeholders. 5. Sales Execution & Revenue Management Maintain strong pipeline discipline and provide accurate sales forecasts and business updates. Track opportunities, conversion, revenue performance, and account potential. Develop account plans and contribute to market expansion and go-to-market initiatives. Consistently work towards and exceed agreed business and revenue targets. Qualifications & Experience 7–10 years of experience in Client Relationship Management, Business Development, Enterprise Sales, Key Account Management, or Strategic Partnerships. Relevant experience in Background Verification / Employee Screening is strongly preferred. Established relationships and industry connects within HR, Talent Acquisition, Staffing, IT/ITES, BFSI, GCCs, or enterprise organizations will be a strong advantage. Proven ability to generate business through an existing network and convert relationships into revenue. Strong track record of client acquisition, account growth, and achievement of business targets. Experience engaging senior stakeholders and managing complex B2B sales cycles. Existing relationships with HR, TA, Staffing, Compliance, Procurement, or business decision-makers will be highly valued. The role provides expert leadership across SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM), Cash and Liquidity Management, Bank Communication Management (BCM), payment processing, banking integrations, Electronic Bank Statements (EBS), and SAP FI/CO integration. The role acts as a senior functional lead and key interface between business stakeholders, Treasury, Finance, banks, vendors, technical teams, and SAP delivery teams. 1. SAP Treasury & Risk Management Lead SAP Treasury implementations, rollouts, upgrades, enhancements, and production support. Configure and support Cash and Liquidity Management, Cash Position, Liquidity Forecasting, Liquidity Planning, and Bank Account Management. Provide functional expertise across Transaction Manager, Money Market, FX, Securities, Derivatives, Loans, Investments, Market Risk, Credit Risk, Exposure Management, Hedge Management, and Hedge Accounting. Support Treasury accounting, valuation, settlement, and integration with SAP Finance. 2. Banking Integration & Payment Processing Lead end-to-end SAP banking integration and payment transformation initiatives. Support payment processing, centralized payments, payment factory operations, cash pooling, and related banking processes. Integrate SAP with banks using ISO 20022/pain.001, CAMT.053, MT940, BAI2, SWIFT, Host-to-Host, SFTP, APIs, and SAP Multi-Bank Connectivity. Lead end-to-end payment testing from SAP payment proposal through bank processing, payment status, bank statement, and reconciliation. 3. Integrate BCM with automatic payment programs such as F110. Support POBO, COBO, ROBO, internal payments, netting, cash pooling, and payment factory processes where applicable. Ensure payment controls, approval governance, audit compliance, and segregation of duties. 4. Configure and troubleshoot external transaction codes, posting rules, account symbols, clearing rules, and automatic account determination. Resolve EBS processing, automatic clearing, reconciliation, and bank statement posting issues. Ensure accurate reconciliation between banks, SAP FI, Treasury, and external systems. 5. Support accounting integration for Treasury transactions, payments, bank statements, cash flows, valuations, settlements, and reconciliations. Mentor consultants and drive knowledge transfer, cross-training, documentation, and capability development. Manage risks, issues, dependencies, escalations, and delivery governance. 9. title: Assistant General Manager - HR Operations
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Role Purpose 
 To lead and control HR operations across the organisation, ensuring accurate employee administration, effective HR systems, consistent implementation of policies, statutory compliance and timely HR support throughout the employee lifecycle. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 HR Operations Strategy 
 Develop and implement HR operations policies, SOPs and service standards. Align HR operational processes with the companys business plans and showroom expansion. Standardise HR practices across the corporate office, regions and showrooms. Prepare the annual HR operations plan and budget. 
 Employee Lifecycle Management 
 Oversee all employee processes from joining through separation. Ensure timely completion of appointment letters, confirmations, transfers, promotions, increments and relieving documents. Monitor probation and confirmation schedules. Ensure accurate documentation for employee movements and status changes. Coordinate smooth onboarding and exit-clearance processes. 
 HR Policies and SOPs 
 Develop, review and update HR policies in consultation with the CHRO and management. Communicate HR policies clearly across all locations. Ensure uniform interpretation and implementation of policies. Maintain proper approval controls and policy documentation. Conduct periodic policy-awareness programmes. 
 Attendance, Leave and Workforce Administration 
 Control attendance, leave, shift, weekly-off and holiday-management processes. Ensure attendance is closed accurately and submitted to Payroll within the defined timeline. Monitor late attendance, absenteeism, unauthorised leave and excessive overtime. Ensure showroom duty rosters comply with business and legal requirements. Resolve attendance and leave discrepancies promptly. 
 Payroll Coordination 
 Provide verified employee data and attendance inputs to the Payroll team. Validate new joiners, exits, salary revisions,incentives, recoveries and deductions. Ensure payroll inputs are accurate and submitted according to schedule. Review payroll exceptions and resolve employee salary concerns. Maintain maker-checker and approval controls for all payroll-related changes. 
 HRMS and Employee Records 
 Ensure the HRMS contains complete and accurate employee information. Lead HR process automation and digitisation initiatives. Maintain employee personal files, service records and statutory documents. Control access to confidential employee information. Conduct regular HRMS and employee-file audits. Generate reliable HR data and reports for management decisions. 
 Regional and Showroom HR Operations 
 Guide Regional HR Managers and showroom HR representatives. Ensure HR policies and processes are followed consistently across all locations. Conduct periodic HR operational audits of regions and showrooms. Resolve escalated employee and manager queries. Support new-showroom openings, employee transfers and workforce deployment. 
 Employee Relations and Grievances 
 Establish a structured employee grievance-resolution process. Ensure employee complaints are acknowledged, investigated and closed within defined timelines. Support disciplinary enquiries and corrective-action processes. Guide regional and functional managers in handling employee issues. Maintain confidentiality and fairness in all employee-related matters. Coordinate with the Employee Relations or Legal team when necessary. 
 Statutory Compliance and Audit Support 
 Coordinate compliance relating to employment records, working hours, leave, notices and statutory registers. Work with the Compliance, Payroll and Legal teams on labour-law requirements. Ensure timely closure of HR audit observations. Provide employee documents and records during internal, statutory and management audits. Monitor compliance requirements across different states. 
 Separation and Full-and-Final Settlement 
 Ensure resignations and terminations follow the approved process and delegation of authority. Monitor notice periods, handover, clearances and recovery of company assets. Coordinate timely full-and-final settlements with Payroll and Finance. Ensure relieving and experience letters are issued after completing all requirements. Conduct exit interviews and analyse reasons for attrition. Recommend corrective action to improve employee retention. 
 HR Budget and Vendor Management 
 Prepare and monitor the HR operations budget. Manage HR vendors such as background-verification agencies, HRMS providers, manpower contractors and documentation services. Evaluate vendor performance, service quality and cost efficiency. Ensure proper agreements, approvals and invoice verification. 
 HR MIS and Management Reporting 
 Prepare weekly and monthly HR dashboards for the CHRO and management. Report employee strength, vacancies, joining, exits, transfers, absenteeism and attrition. Track regional and department-wise employee costs. Analyse HR trends and highlight risks requiring management attention. Maintain a single, reliable source of employee data. 
 Team Leadership 
 Lead HR Operations Managers, Deputy Managers, Assistant Managers and Executives. Define team responsibilities, service-level standards and performance targets. Review team productivity and quality of work. Train team members on HR policies, HRMS, documentation and compliance. Develop suitable successors for key HR operations positions. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or an equivalent qualification. Approximately 1520 years of HR experience, including at least 5 years in a senior HR operations role. Experience in large retail, jewellery, FMCG or other multi-location organisations is preferred. Strong knowledge of HR operations, HRMS, labour compliance, payroll coordination and employee relations. 
 Key Competencies Multi-location HR operations management HR policy development and implementation HRMS and process automation Employee lifecycle management Labour-law and statutory-compliance knowledge Data analysis and management reporting Problem-solving and decision-making Team leadership and stakeholder management Confidentiality, integrity and attention to detail

Key Skills: HR MIS,HR Operations,HR Budgeting,Employee Life Cycle,HR Policies,Payroll Management,HRIS,Grievance Management

Coordinate with application and infrastructure teams for certificate deployments. Operations & Service Management Monitor operational dashboards and alerts. Required Technical Skills Strong experience with Infoblox DNS, DHCP, and IPAM administration. title: Service Desk Quality Analyst
description:
OVERVIEW 
The Service Desk Quality Analyst supports the Service Desk operation by ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and quality of ticket handling and documentation. While this role primarily operates behind the scenes, it may occasionally involve handling service tickets to support operational needs or gain deeper insight into service patterns. Key responsibilities include reviewing ticket coding for accuracy, interpreting dashboards, identifying recurring issues, and converting data into actionable insights for service leads. Tasks involve auditing tickets, flagging miscategorized entries, reporting on Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance, monitoring backlog trends, and assisting problem management through thorough data analysis. Acting as an extension of the quality function, this role plays a critical part in enhancing ticket hygiene, improving team performance, and delivering operational insights that drive continuous service desk improvements.
 DESCRIPTION The Service Desk Quality Analyst is a mid-level role that works closely with the Service Desk team and leadership to: Monitor incoming new tickets in the Service Desk system to ensure timely and accurate assignment to the appropriate team members Monitor incoming escalations to promptly identify high-priority or complex issues requiring immediate attention from Senior Analysts or Service Desk management Maintain real-time oversight of ticket queues and escalation paths to prevent bottlenecks and service delays Provide backup support to Service Desk Analysts by handling tickets as needed during peak periods, absences, or resource shortages, helping maintain consistent service levels Review and audit service desk tickets for coding accuracy and categorization Identify and flag misclassified or incomplete entries Monitor SLA compliance and generate weekly/monthly performance reports Analyze incident and request trends to identify recurring issues and opportunities for automation or documentation improvements Track backlog trends and report on resolution times Provide support in problem management by conducting comprehensive, data-driven root cause analysis Interpret dashboards and translate technical data into clear, actionable insights for service improvement Contribute to quality improvement initiatives by highlighting gaps and supporting process documentation Use dashboards (e.g., Zoho ManageEngine, ServiceNow, Jira) to extract performance insights Assist with the standardization of ticket documentation practices Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure consistency in incident reporting and documentation Full-time role with rotational shifts based on business requirements Collaborate with Service Desk leads and quality teams to translate data insights into actionable recommendations Assist in documenting known issues, process updates, and best practices to support continuous improvement initiatives Participate in team meetings and quality reviews, sharing insights that help drive service enhancements Track and analyze the volume and types of escalations to identify training needs for Service Desk staff Complete all other tasks deemed appropriate for the role and assigned by the manager/supervisor. 
 REQUIRED SKILLS Process Documentation skills Advanced Excel skills Ability to deep dive into numbers and draw conclusions Understanding of Root Cause Analysis Strong reasoning and analytical skills Time Management and prioritization Multi-tasking capabilities Ability to manage several priorities at once Ability to focus for long periods of time to determine a solution Strong communication skills (both written and verbal) Organize thoughts and communicate verbal messages appropriately to listeners and situations Demonstrated proficiency in grammar and typing skills Comfortable with repetitive tasks Good attention to detail and willingness to learn Ability to work independently Willingness to cooperate with others and work for the greater good.

title: Service Desk Quality Analyst
description:
OVERVIEW 
The Service Desk Quality Analyst supports the Service Desk operation by ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and quality of ticket handling and documentation. While this role primarily operates behind the scenes, it may occasionally involve handling service tickets to support operational needs or gain deeper insight into service patterns. Key responsibilities include reviewing ticket coding for accuracy, interpreting dashboards, identifying recurring issues, and converting data into actionable insights for service leads. Tasks involve auditing tickets, flagging miscategorized entries, reporting on Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance, monitoring backlog trends, and assisting problem management through thorough data analysis. Acting as an extension of the quality function, this role plays a critical part in enhancing ticket hygiene, improving team performance, and delivering operational insights that drive continuous service desk improvements.
 DESCRIPTION The Service Desk Quality Analyst is a mid-level role that works closely with the Service Desk team and leadership to: Monitor incoming new tickets in the Service Desk system to ensure timely and accurate assignment to the appropriate team members Monitor incoming escalations to promptly identify high-priority or complex issues requiring immediate attention from Senior Analysts or Service Desk management Maintain real-time oversight of ticket queues and escalation paths to prevent bottlenecks and service delays Provide backup support to Service Desk Analysts by handling tickets as needed during peak periods, absences, or resource shortages, helping maintain consistent service levels Review and audit service desk tickets for coding accuracy and categorization Identify and flag misclassified or incomplete entries Monitor SLA compliance and generate weekly/monthly performance reports Analyze incident and request trends to identify recurring issues and opportunities for automation or documentation improvements Track backlog trends and report on resolution times Provide support in problem management by conducting comprehensive, data-driven root cause analysis Interpret dashboards and translate technical data into clear, actionable insights for service improvement Contribute to quality improvement initiatives by highlighting gaps and supporting process documentation Use dashboards (e.g., Zoho ManageEngine, ServiceNow, Jira) to extract performance insights Assist with the standardization of ticket documentation practices Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure consistency in incident reporting and documentation Full-time role with rotational shifts based on business requirements Collaborate with Service Desk leads and quality teams to translate data insights into actionable recommendations Assist in documenting known issues, process updates, and best practices to support continuous improvement initiatives Participate in team meetings and quality reviews, sharing insights that help drive service enhancements Track and analyze the volume and types of escalations to identify training needs for Service Desk staff Complete all other tasks deemed appropriate for the role and assigned by the manager/supervisor. 
 REQUIRED SKILLS Process Documentation skills Advanced Excel skills Ability to deep dive into numbers and draw conclusions Understanding of Root Cause Analysis Strong reasoning and analytical skills Time Management and prioritization Multi-tasking capabilities Ability to manage several priorities at once Ability to focus for long periods of time to determine a solution Strong communication skills (both written and verbal) Organize thoughts and communicate verbal messages appropriately to listeners and situations Demonstrated proficiency in grammar and typing skills Comfortable with repetitive tasks Good attention to detail and willingness to learn Ability to work independently Willingness to cooperate with others and work for the greater good. 
 REQUIRED EXPEREINCE & QUALIFICATIONS A year of phone, email, or chat support experience in IT Service Desk, Helpdesk, Technical Support, or US customer support experience Two years of data analysis and reporting or a Bachelors degree in IT, Computer Science, Business, or a related field Familiar with ITIL and its processes, specifically those related to Service Request, Incident, Change, and Problem Management Knowledge of Customer Service principles and practices Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., Zoho Manage Engine, ServiceNow, Jira) Understanding of SLA metrics Experience in process documentation 
 DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE Analytics / Data analysis and reporting in a Call Center or Service Desk environment Work experience in the Pharma industry Knowledge of computer fundamentals, software/web application Strong troubleshooting skills.

description:

This role requires a strong mix of consultative selling, solution positioning, stakeholder management, and deal ownership, working closely with pre-sales, delivery, alliances, and leadership teams. Consultative & Solution-Led Selling Engage with customer stakeholders to understand business challenges, IT landscape, and cloud maturity. Cloud & Hyperscaler Ecosystem Engagement Work closely with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud partner teams. Participate in joint GTM motions, co-selling, and partner-led opportunities. Understand hyperscaler programs, incentives, and funding mechanisms. Support joint marketing initiatives, events, and customer workshops. 5. Sales Planning, Forecasting & Reporting Maintain accurate sales forecasts and pipeline updates in CRM. Track key sales metrics including pipeline velocity, win rates, deal size, and conversion ratios. Provide regular reports and insights to sales leadership. Contribute to territory planning and account prioritization. 6. Collaboration with Internal Teams Work closely with Pre-Sales, Delivery, Cloud Architects, GenAI teams, and Marketing. Ensure smooth handover from sales to delivery. Provide customer feedback to solution and leadership teams for continuous improvement. Support proposal development, RFP responses, and customer presentations. Required Skills & Experience Minimum 7–8 years of experience in Cloud Solutions / IT Services Sales. Proven track record of selling Cloud Migration, Cloud Managed Services, Cloud Optimization, and Security solutions. Experience selling services on AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud. Ability to engage with senior business and technology stakeholders. Strong negotiation, deal structuring, and closing skills. Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. Technical & Domain Understanding Good understanding of: Cloud infrastructure & platforms Cloud migration & modernization Managed services & support models Security, compliance, and governance Cost optimization and FinOps concepts Ability to translate technical solutions into clear business value. Communication & Presentation Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong presentation and storytelling ability. Comfortable presenting to CXOs and senior leadership. Education Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or Business (MBA preferred). Relevant cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP – Sales or Foundation level) are a plus. What We Offer Opportunity to work in a high-growth Cloud & GenAI practice. Exposure to cutting-edge Cloud, AI, and Generative AI solutions. Collaborative, entrepreneurial work environment. Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives. Direct interaction with enterprise customers and hyperscaler partners. Who Should Apply Cloud sales professionals looking to move beyond transactional selling. Candidates excited about Cloud + GenAI convergence. Self-driven individuals who can own accounts and build long-term customer relationships.

 About the Role 
We are looking for a motivated and technically interested Industrial Magnet Sales Executive to join our B2B sales team.
The candidate will be responsible for identifying industrial customers, connecting with decision-makers, scheduling appointments, visiting customers, understanding their magnet requirements, and developing business opportunities.
Our products include Rare Earth Magnets, Permanent Magnets, and Neodymium (NdFeB) Magnets used in various industrial applications, including motors, EV motors, BLDC motors, automation, pumps and other manufacturing applications.
A Chemistry background is required because the candidate should be able to understand basic material and magnet-related specifications and communicate effectively with customers.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Identify and research potential B2B industrial customers across India. Generate leads through online research, databases, references, cold calling and other sources. Contact companies and decision-makers to understand their requirements. Schedule appointments before visiting customers . Visit industrial customers and manufacturing units for business development. Understand the customer's product, motor/application and magnet requirement. Identify whether the customer is using NdFeB, ferrite or other permanent magnets . Collect technical requirements such as magnet type, grade, size, shape, coating, tolerance and application. Coordinate with the technical/internal team for drawings, samples, specifications and quotations. Follow up with customers from initial enquiry to quotation, sample approval and order. Maintain accurate records of leads, customer meetings, requirements, quotations and follow-ups. Develop long-term relationships with Purchase, Procurement, R&D, Motor Design and management teams. Achieve assigned sales and lead-generation targets. Travel to different cities and states across India for customer meetings when required. Target Customers / Industries 
The candidate will primarily target manufacturers and companies using magnets in their products, including:
 EV manufacturers and EV motor manufacturers Electric 2-wheeler and 3-wheeler manufacturers EV component and e-axle manufacturers Industrial motor manufacturers BLDC, PMSM and servo motor manufacturers DC motor manufacturers Fan and BLDC fan manufacturers Pump and compressor manufacturers Automation and robotics companies Wind-energy equipment manufacturers Elevator and traction-machine manufacturers Automotive component manufacturers Electronics and sensor manufacturers The sales guide highlights EV/automotive, BLDC fans, industrial motors, wind, elevators, solar pumps, robotics/automation and pumps as key target sectors.
 What the Candidate Needs to Understand 
The candidate does not need extensive prior magnet-sales experience. However, they should be willing to learn about:
 Permanent magnets Rare Earth Magnets Neodymium (NdFeB) Magnets Ferrite Magnets Basic magnet grades and specifications Magnet dimensions, shape and coating Motor applications EV and DC/BLDC/PMSM motor applications Industrial B2B sales processes For example, NdFeB magnets are used in EV motors, industrial motors, robotics, automation, speakers and sensors.
 Candidate Profile 
 Graduate with Chemistry background is mandatory. Freshers are welcome. Strong interest in building a career in B2B/industrial sales . Good communication and interpersonal skills. Confident in speaking with company owners, purchase managers and technical teams. Comfortable making cold calls and following up with customers. Willing to visit factories and industrial areas. Willing to travel anywhere in India for customer meetings. Good basic understanding of Chemistry/materials is preferred. Must be willing to learn technical product specifications. Basic knowledge of MS Excel, email and CRM/lead management is preferred. Having a two-wheeler and a valid driving licence would be an advantage. Sales Process 
The candidate will generally follow this process:
 Lead Generation Customer Calling Requirement Identification Appointment Customer Visit Technical Requirement Collection Quotation Follow-up Sample/Approval Order 
The candidate should focus on understanding the customer's actual application and requirements rather than simply asking whether they need magnets.
 Key Performance Indicators 
Performance will be evaluated based on:
 Number of qualified B2B leads generated Number of customer calls Appointments scheduled Customer visits completed New customer accounts developed Quotations generated Follow-ups and conversion Sales revenue generated Customer relationship development Accuracy of customer/technical information collected Important Requirement 
 This is a field-oriented B2B industrial sales role. Candidates must be comfortable with customer visits and travelling across India. 
The candidate should have the ability to communicate with both commercial and technical contacts , including Purchase Managers, Procurement teams, R&D/Motor Design teams and business owners.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: SALES EXECUTIVE
 Company: Schepper Enterprise Pvt. Ltd.
 Position: Sales Executive And Metal Ceiling Solutions
 Location: Hyderabad, Telangana
 Department: Sales & Business Development
 Reporting To: Sales Manager / Business Head
 Experience: Minimum 1 Year
 Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Purpose
The Sales Executive will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and managing existing customers for Schepper Enterprise Pvt. Ltd. And Metal Ceiling Solutions.
The role will focus on generating enquiries, developing relationships with architects, interior designers, contractors, builders, dealers and distributors, identifying upcoming projects, conducting customer and site visits, preparing quotations, following up on enquiries and converting opportunities into orders.
The candidate will be responsible for actively developing the Hyderabad market and contributing towards achieving the company's sales and business development objectives.
Key Responsibilities
Sales & Business Development
 Identify and develop new business opportunities in the assigned territory. Generate leads through market visits, references, networking and other business development activities. Visit architects, interior designers, contractors, builders, dealers, distributors, corporates and other potential customers. Develop and maintain strong professional relationships with customers and channel partners. Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable metal ceiling solutions. Generate enquiries and ensure regular follow-up for conversion into orders. Prepare and share quotations and other required commercial documents. Negotiate with customers within approved company guidelines. Achieve assigned monthly and yearly sales targets. Maintain regular follow-up with existing customers for repeat business. Project & Site Coordination
 Identify upcoming construction, commercial, residential and interior projects in the Hyderabad market. Conduct regular project and site visits to understand customer requirements. Coordinate with architects, contractors, consultants and other project stakeholders. Understand basic product specifications, quantities, drawings and project requirements. Coordinate with internal Production, Operations, Execution and Dispatch teams for order-related requirements. Follow up on order status and delivery schedules. Coordinate with concerned teams to resolve customer queries and issues. Market & Channel Development
 Develop a database of architects, interior designers, contractors, builders, dealers and distributors. Identify new projects and potential business opportunities at an early stage. Explore opportunities to expand Schepper's dealer and distributor network. Monitor competitor activities, pricing, products and market trends. Provide regular market feedback to the Sales Manager / Business Head. Reporting & Documentation
 Maintain daily customer and project visit reports. Maintain records of enquiries, quotations, follow-ups and orders. Update customer and project information regularly. Ensure timely follow-up on pending quotations and enquiries. Prepare sales reports as required by management. Qualification & Skills
 Qualification: Any Graduate. Experience: Minimum 1 year of relevant sales experience. Industry Experience: Experience in building materials, construction materials, interior products, ceiling products, architectural products or related industries is mandatory. Strong communication and negotiation skills. Good customer relationship management skills. Strong follow-up and coordination abilities. Target-oriented, confident, energetic and self-motivated. Willingness to travel extensively for customer, market and project visits. Basic computer knowledge is required. Working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Office, email and sales reporting tools. Ability to understand basic product specifications, drawings, quantities and project requirements. Two-wheeler and valid driving licence are mandatory. Key Performance Areas
 Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets. New customer acquisition. New project acquisition. Enquiry-to-order conversion. Customer and project visits. Dealer/distributor network development. Follow-up and conversion of quotations. Customer relationship and repeat business. Timely submission of sales reports. Development of the assigned Hyderabad market. Compensation
 Salary: As per industry standards, based on experience, skills and suitability for the position.
Work Location
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat & Hyderabad, Telangana.

title: Manager II, Engineering - Confluent
description:
Your Role and Responsibilities: About the Role The Connect Cloud Platform team owns the control plane that powers every connector running in Confluent Cloud, giving customers a reliable way to create, configure, and manage their connectors. The team also owns hybrid connector management, which extends this control plane so customers can manage on prem Connect clusters from Confluent Cloud through a single pane of glass, and contributes to the ongoing architectural evolution of the control plane as Connect scales. As an Engineering Manager II, you will own a team of senior and junior engineers building this control plane. Correctness is paramount in this domain: the team is accountable for making sure every connector request is processed reliably and that customer intent is honored consistently, given the cost and compliance implications of getting it wrong. You will partner closely with product, peer engineering teams across Confluent Cloud and Confluent Platform, and adjacent platform teams, to turn customer and product needs into a clear roadmap and a team that executes against it with a high bar for operational excellence. What You Will Do Own execution for the Connect control plane, including connector lifecycle APIs and the underlying metadata and state management, while partnering on the hybrid connector management initiative that extends this ownership. Partner with product management, engineering leadership, and cross functional stakeholders to define quarterly milestones and drive delivery of multi quarter roadmap commitments. Break down complex, cross team initiatives into meaningful milestones, surface dependencies and blockers early, and keep execution aligned to business priorities as requirements evolve. Lead a team of both senior and junior engineers, creating clarity on goals, providing regular coaching and feedback, and helping individuals grow in line with the career progression guide. Own the health of the team's on call and operational practices, including incident response, root cause reviews, and reducing recurring operational toil, given the team sits directly in the path of every connector operation customers run. Represent the team in technical discussions, design reviews, and postmortems, and help raise the bar for architecture, execution, and engineering process across the broader Connect organization. Translate product asks and customer needs into engineering requirements and delivery plans that balance feature velocity, technical debt, reliability, and long term architectural integrity. Build a healthy, inclusive, high trust team culture with psychological safety, strong engagement, and clear accountability. Partner with recruiting to attract, assess, and close strong engineering talent, while maintaining a high hiring bar and a strong candidate experience. Required Education: Bachelor's Degree Preferred education Master's Degree Required Technical and Professional Expertise: 8+ years of relevant software engineering experience and 2+ years of people management experience leading engineers in distributed systems, platform, or infrastructure focused teams. Strong technical depth in distributed systems, with the ability to weigh in credibly on API design, data consistency, and operational trade offs. Experience delivering multi quarter or cross team initiatives with clear business impact, including managing dependencies, shifting priorities, and execution risk. Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, align teams around outcomes, and keep work moving even while strategy is still being refined. Demonstrated strength in coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development for engineers across different levels of seniority. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and other cross functional partners. Experience hiring and building balanced, high performing teams with strong attention to inclusion, team health, and long term talent development. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Technical and Professional Experience: Experience with Apache Kafka, Kafka Connect, Confluent Platform, or adjacent streaming and data integration technologies. Experience owning control plane or management plane systems, including REST APIs and state management for distributed resources. Familiarity with Kubernetes, cloud native platforms, and hybrid deployment models spanning on prem and cloud, across AWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience leading teams responsible for correctness critical, customer facing platform experiences, where request loss or state drift has direct customer and cost impact. title: Sap Ui5 Developer
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Custom Software Engineer Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. Must have skills : SAP UI5 Development Good to have skills : NA Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary AI Powered Tech Talent Build AI native, enterprise-grade user experiences using SAPUI5 (and the broader SAP Fiori paradigm), combining deep front end engineering skills with agentic AI patterns (LLM-integrated UX, tool-augmented interactions, and evaluation loops). The focus is to move beyond forms and screens into intelligent, guided, and adaptive SAP experiences that help users complete business tasks fasterwhile maintaining performance, accessibility, security, and reliability at enterprise scale. Core Responsibilities 1) Enterprise UI Engineering with SAPUI5 Build responsive, user-friendly SAPUI5 interfaces using MVC architecture, component-based patterns, and standard UI5 application structure. Develop and customize UI5 applications using JavaScript and modern front-end foundations (JSON, CSS), following disciplined source control practices (Git). 2) Data Interaction & Service Consumption (OData-first mindset) Implement robust data flows using OData and service mocking practices for development and testing scenarios (e.g. mock services). Design client-side models, bindings, and interaction patterns that scale across complex enterprise datasets. 3) AI Native UX: LLM-Integrated and Agentic Interfaces (AI native build expectation) Embed AI-driven experiences directly into UI flows (e.g., assist in the moment interactions) where the UI can interpret intent, propose next steps, and generate contextual guidance. Implement tool-augmented UI patterns (front-end orchestration that can call approved tools/services), with clear user confirmation steps and safe action boundaries. Build retrieval-grounded UI interactions (RAG-style grounding) where AI outputs must stay tied to enterprise knowledge and business context, with deterministic fallbacks when grounding is weak. 4) Testing, Quality & UX Reliability Build automated test coverage with a strong testing approach for UI components using unit and acceptance testing patterns (e.g., QUnit and one page acceptance tests/OPA style approaches). Optimize performance and maintainability: reduce UI bloat, apply reusable components, and enforce consistent coding standards for long-term supportability. 5) SAP Fiori-aligned Experience Design Apply SAP Fiori s design principles and UX paradigm to deliver role-based, consistent experiences across devices, aligned to modern SAP UX expectations. Understand the ecosystem positioning of SAPUI5 and OpenUI5 and make informed choices based on enterprise constraints and licensing contexts. 6) Iteration, Delivery & Collaboration Prototype quickly, demo frequently, and iterate with business stakeholders—then harden into production-ready UI solutions with observability and regression testing for both UI and AI behaviors. Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have) Strong hands-on expertise in SAP UI5 / SAPUI5 development and enterprise UI engineering fundamentals. Mastery of MVC architecture, responsive UI construction, and component-driven development in SAP UI5 contexts. Solid implementation experience with OData and service mocking approaches for development/test workflows. Strong front-end foundations: JavaScript + JSON + CSS, with Git-based collaboration. AI-native build capability: designing UX that integrates LLM behaviors with grounding, tool use, and evaluation loops (owned by the role). (AI native expectation not a claim about a specific SAP feature.) Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills SAP Fiori design paradigm familiarity and ability to translate UX principles into scalable UI solutions. Testing depth for SAPUI5 applications using the testing approaches referenced in learning assets. Understanding of SAPUI5 vs OpenUI5 positioning and implications for enterprise delivery. What This Role Does Not Center On Not limited to AI-assisted coding or only using copilots this role builds AI-native UI behaviors and owns their quality (grounding, safety boundaries, evaluation). Not focused on model training emphasis is on productizing intelligent experiences in the UI layer with reliable integration patterns. Value Delivered Enterprise SAP applications with modern, responsive SAPUI5 interfaces aligned to SAP Fiori UX expectations. Faster user outcomes through AI-native in-flow guidance and agentic task completion patterns (grounded, safe, and measurable). Higher reliability via disciplined testing practices for UI components and acceptance flows. Additional Information A 15 years full time education is required" Premium SAP UI5 Development

 You will also act as a Product Owner within the scrum team, managing the product backlog of requirements, priority and necessary clarification. Document user stories and requirements, process flows, UI and UX mockups Work with tokenization, encryption, and security standards (PCI-DSS, 3DS, HSM, etc.) to ensure secure transactions. Product & Stakeholder Engagement Partner with product managers to shape the payments roadmap and define requirements based on business needs and market trends. Work within an Agile/Scrum environment, contributing to sprint planning, managing backlog refinement, and user story definition. Take a lead role in showcasing functionality which is being developed to stakeholders, seeking early feedback Collaborate with other Business Analysts and colleagues, providing training and understanding of the payments industry and TNS services. Qualifications Experience/Qualifications: 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in the payments industry. Experience working with protocols such as ISO 8583, NEXO, EMV, and alternative payment methods. Experience working with acquirers, PSPs, and payment processors. Hands-on experience with payment APIs, RESTful web services, and JSON/XML messaging. Understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks (e.g., PCI-DSS, PSD2, SCA). Ability to write clear BRDs, functional specifications, and API documentation. Manage and maintain the product backlog, working as a product owner within a scrum team. Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment. If you are passionate about technology, love personal growth and opportunity, come see what TNS is all about!

title: Software Engineer, Tech Solutions
description:
Company Profile Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world s most ambitious changemakers define the future. Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes. The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals - serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics - who support our offices globally. Our mantra of shared innovation, seamless execution, underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally. What makes us a great place to work We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. Job Summary We are hiring a Software Engineer to solve real business problems for the functions that keep Bain running. From Finance to Legal, HR, Risk, and more you will build full-stack software, AI agents, integrations, and workflow products that turn messy, ambiguous business needs into reliable, working software. You will partner closely with the people who use what you ship ensuring it is correct, reliable, maintainable, and clearly communicated. This role suits high-initiative builders with strong software fundamentals who treat AI as a force multiplier - using it not only to deliver more, but to deliver faster, more efficiently, and to a higher standard. What Makes This Role Different You will work on real business problems with users close enough to give fast feedback. You will use AI development tools as part of the normal engineering workflow, not as a side experiment. You will be encouraged to compress the path from idea to working software without lowering the engineering bar. You will build across the stack: frontend, backend, data, APIs, integrations, and agentic workflows. You will be expected to ship quickly while still writing code that another engineer can understand, test, and extend. You will learn across domains instead of specializing only in one platform or one automation tool. What You Will Build Internal tools that turn messy business processes into structured, trackable workflows. AI agents that draft, check, route, summarize, or monitor work with appropriate human review. Full-stack applications for Bain teams that need reliable software, not one-off scripts. Integrations across documents, tickets, databases, collaboration tools, and internal platforms. Prototypes that move quickly and can be hardened into maintainable production systems when the value is proven. Principal Accountabilities and % of time Build full-stack solutions (45%) Own contained projects and features from problem clarification through launch. Build backend services, frontend interfaces, data models, APIs, integrations, and workflow logic that solve practical business problems. 
Use AI to accelerate delivery (20%) Use tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Replit, or similar tools to plan, code, test, debug, document, and refactor. Validate AI output before it reaches users. 
Translate business ambiguity into software (15%) Clarify user needs, prioritize MVP features, ask probing questions, and choose practical technical approaches. Partner with senior engineers on broader architecture, security, and production-readiness decisions. 
 Maintain quality and reliability (15%) Write readable, modular code; add useful tests; debug issues across the stack; document important decisions; and support solutions after launch. 
 Collaborate and learn(5%) Work with business stakeholders, product owners, senior engineers, and other technology teams. Share reusable prompts, patterns, components, and lessons learned. What Good Looks Like You can break down a broad business problem, define the first useful solution, and deliver a working result. You use AI tools fluently but do not outsource judgment to them. You can explain your code, debug it, test it, and improve it after feedback. You communicate trade-offs clearly to both engineers and business users. You recognize when to keep a solution simple and when to ask for senior engineering guidance. 
 Qualifications Experience We are looking for someone who has: 3-5 years of professional software development experience Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. A track record of shipping working software, whether in production roles, substantial internships, or serious personal projects. Experience using AI-assisted development tools as part of a real engineering workflow, or clear evidence of adopting them quickly and responsibly. Comfort working through ambiguity, making pragmatic trade-offs, and communicating clearly with both engineers and business users. 
 Required: Strong coding fundamentals, including data structures, APIs, debugging, testing, and basic software design. Working ability in at least one general-purpose programming language used for production software, ideally Python, TypeScript, or JavaScript. Familiarity with SQL, relational data modeling, web applications, REST APIs, Git, pull requests, and code review. Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools, or clear evidence that you can adopt them quickly and responsibly. Ability to work through ambiguity, ask good questions, make pragmatic trade-offs, and communicate clearly. 
 Preferred: Experience with Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, React, Svelte, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, or cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS. Experience integrating with enterprise systems and APIs such as Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Jira, ServiceNow, Slack, or Teams. Familiarity with LLM application patterns such as structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval, evals, prompt versioning, guardrails, memory, and human approval flows. Experience building internal tools, workflow products, business process software, or AI-enabled applications. Exposure to Power Platform, RPA tools, n8n, Zapier, or Make is helpful but not required.

title: Customer relationship-Japanese professional
description:
Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people-Kyndryls-that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. 
 The Role Customer relationship role at Kyndryl are project-based subject matter experts in all things - good at providing analysis, documenting and diagraming work for hand-off, offering timely solutions, and generally figuring it out. This is a hands-on role where your feel for the interaction between a system and its environment will be invaluable to every one of your clients. 
 
 There are two halves to this role: First, contributing to current projects where you analyze problems and tech issues, offer solutions, and test, modify, automate, and integrate systems. And second, long-range strategic planning of IT infrastructure and operational execution. This role isn t specific to any one platform, so you ll need a good feel for all of them. And because of this, you ll experience variety and growth at Kyndryl that you won t find anywhere else. 
 
 You ll be involved early to offer solutions, help decide whether something can be done, and identify the technical and timeline risks up front. This means dealing with both client expectations and internal challenges - in other words, there are plenty of opportunities to make a difference, and a lot of people will witness your contributions. In fact, a frequent sign of success for our Infrastructure Specialists is when clients come back to us and ask for the same person by name. That s the kind of impact you can have! 
 
 This is a project-based role where you ll enjoy deep involvement throughout the lifespan of a project, as well as the chance to work closely with Architects, Technicians, and PMs. Whatever your current level of tech savvy or where you want your career to lead, you ll find the right opportunities and a buddy to support your growth. Boredom Trust us, that won t be an issue. 
 
 Your future at Kyndryl 
 There are lots of opportunities to gain certification and qualifications on the job, and you ll continuously grow as a Cloud Hyperscaler. title: Software Development Engineer II (Backend) - Contacts
description:
Job Summary 
 The Contacts Team sits at the heart of HighLevel's CRM platform and powers contact management capabilities consumed across workflows, conversations, campaigns, opportunities, integrations, and other product surfaces. We are looking for an SDE-2 Backend Engineer who enjoys building scalable backend services and solving real-world engineering problems around APIs, data processing, reliability, and performance. You will work alongside senior engineers to design and build backend services while gradually taking independent ownership of services and features from development through production. 
 
 What We Expect 
 Strong ownership of backend services and features from development through production. Ability to independently design, develop, test, and deploy scalable backend solutions. Passion for writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. A collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and infrastructure teams. Focus on improving performance, scalability, reliability, and developer productivity. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Backend Engineering 
 Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript. Build and maintain REST APIs consumed by multiple HighLevel products and services. Write clean, maintainable, testable, and production-quality code. Work with high-volume datasets and optimize database queries and data-access patterns. Develop asynchronous processing flows using queues and event-driven architecture. 
 
 Performance Scalability 
 Identify API and database performance bottlenecks. Work with caching, indexing, batching, and asynchronous processing patterns. Contribute toward improving service latency, throughput, and scalability. Understand how application design impacts systems operating under high request volumes. 
 
 Reliability Production Ownership 
 Monitor production services and investigate failures using logs, metrics, traces, and observability platforms. Debug and resolve production issues. Participate in on-call and incident-resolution processes. Contribute to root-cause analysis and sustainable fixes instead of short-term patches. 
 
 Engineering Quality 
 Write unit/integration tests for new functionality. Participate actively in code reviews. Follow secure coding and engineering best practices. Improve existing code through refactoring and technical-debt reduction. 
 
 Required Skills Experience 
 3+ years of backend development experience. Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and TypeScript/JavaScript. Experience designing and consuming REST APIs. Good understanding of microservices. Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases. Understanding of database indexing and query optimization. Familiarity with asynchronous processing and message queues. Experience with Git, CI/CD and automated testing. Familiarity with Docker. Exposure to AWS/GCP or another major cloud platform. 
 
 Nice to have 
 Experience working on high-scale SaaS products. Redis or similar caching technologies. Elasticsearch/OpenSearch. Kafka, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ or similar messaging systems. Kubernetes Observability platforms such as Grafana, Sentry, ELK or equivalent.

 Function: Strategy

The role will involve understanding business requirements, conducting research and analysis, preparing high-quality presentations and proposals, coordinating with internal stakeholders and helping ensure that projects progress as planned. Prepare briefing notes, management updates and decision documents for senior leadership. 3. Research and Business Analysis Conduct market, industry, competitor and opportunity research. Collect and consolidate information required for strategic initiatives and management reviews. Track actions, dependencies, timelines and decisions across different workstreams. Follow up with stakeholders and highlight delays, risks or unresolved matters. Ensure that agreed actions are properly documented and taken to closure. 5. Support to Strategic Workstreams Support priority initiatives across the company’s existing and emerging business lines. Work with respective project and workstream owners to provide research, analysis, documentation and coordination support. Assist with business planning, new-service development, digital initiatives, partnerships and process-improvement projects. Prepare trackers, reports and management updates for assigned initiatives. Identify dependencies across workstreams and facilitate coordination between relevant stakeholders. Take ownership of defined components of larger projects and gradually assume responsibility for complete projects. Maintain flexibility to support new and evolving priorities of the Strategy team. 6. Project Management and Execution Prepare project plans, activity trackers, timelines and progress reports for strategic initiatives. Monitor milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks and decisions required from management. Coordinate with project stakeholders to support timely implementation. Maintain clear documentation of project discussions, decisions and agreed actions. Take independent ownership of selected project components during the initial period. Gradually manage complete strategic projects from planning through execution and closure. Provide structured and timely updates to management on project progress and concerns. 7. Use of AI and Productivity Tools Use common artificial intelligence tools to support research, analysis, content development, process improvement and productivity. Apply AI tools responsibly while ensuring the accuracy, confidentiality and quality of outputs. Use project management and collaboration tools to maintain project plans, responsibilities, timelines and progress.
