title: Walk-in || Tech lead web Scraping & Data Engineering
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 21 Sep - 22 Sep
Timing: 11.30 AM - 2.00 PM
Venue: Merit Data and Technology Pvt Ltd
SP 52, 3rd Cross St, Ambattur Industrial Estate, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600058
Contact: Vignesh K (8667517474)

Job Description: 
 Primary (70%): Web scraping architecture anti-bot, distributed crawling, proxy/CAPTCHA 
 strategy, compliance 
 •
 •
 Secondary (30%): Data engineering pipelines, lakehouse, orchestration, dbt 
 Mandatory ownership of the technical solution and effort estimation for every new 
 scraping proposal/RFP 
 •
 •
 Senior profile: 9+ years overall, 5+ years in scraping, 4+ years in data engineering 
 Technical Lead / Architect Web Scraping & Data Engineering 
 Role Title Solution Architect Web Scraping (Primary) & Data Engineering (Secondary) 
 Location: Remote 
 Primary Focus Web Scraping & Data Extraction Architecture (~70%) 
 Secondary Focus Data Engineering & Pipeline Architecture (~30%) 
 1. Role Summary: 
 We are seeking a Technical lead the design and delivery of large-scale web scraping and 
 data extraction solutions, with strong supporting expertise in data engineering, the 
 technical authority on all scraping initiatives from pre-sales solutioning and effort 
 estimation through to architecture, build, and stabilization. 
 The primary mandate is web scraping: designing resilient crawlers, anti-bot strategies, 
 distributed extraction systems, and compliance frameworks. The secondary mandate is 
 data engineering: ensuring extracted data flows reliably into well-modelled, query-ready 
 storage layers and downstream analytical or operational systems. 
 Mandatory Involvement Areas: 
 •
 •
 •
 Author or co-author the technical solution section of every new RFP / RFI / proposal 
 document for scraping projects. 
 Lead technical discovery calls with prospective clients to understand target sources, data 
 SLAs, volume, and compliance constraints. 
 Conduct target-site feasibility assessments anti-bot complexity, dynamic content, 
 login walls, geo-restrictions, rate limits and document findings before commercials 
 are committed. 
 •
 •
 Own end-to-end effort estimation for scraping engagements: crawler build effort, 
 infrastructure sizing, proxy and CAPTCHA cost projections, maintenance overhead, and 
 contingency. 
 Produce solution architecture diagrams, tech stack recommendations, and assumption 
 logs as part of every proposal. 
 •
 •
 Define and document SLAs, KPIs, and acceptance criteria proposed to the client. 
 Participate in client orals, technical defence sessions, and commercial negotiations as 
 the technical SPOC. 
 •
 Maintain an internal estimation knowledge base reusable estimation templates, 
 complexity matrices, target-site classification, and historical actuals and continuously 
 refine it after every project closure. 
 
 
 
 •
 Sign off on the technical feasibility and risk profile of every proposal before submission. 
 No scraping proposal goes out without architect approval. 
 3. Core Responsibilities 
 3.1 Scraping Architecture & Design (Primary) 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 •
 Design end-to-end scraping solutions covering crawl orchestration, extraction, parsing, 
 storage, and downstream data consumption. 
 Define reference architectures for high-volume, high-velocity, and high-variety scraping 
 use cases. 
 Architect resilient systems handling JavaScript-heavy sites, CAPTCHAs, rate limiting, IP 
 blocking, and frequent DOM changes. 
 Evaluate and select frameworks, proxy networks, and anti-bot bypass strategies aligned 
 with cost, performance, and compliance. 
 Design data quality, deduplication, validation, and schema-evolution strategies for 
 scraped data. 
 3.2 Data Engineering Architecture (Secondary) 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 •
 Design downstream data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve scraped data to 
 analytics, ML, or operational consumers. 
 Architect lakehouse / warehouse layers, define data modelling standards (dimensional, 
 Data Vault, or hybrid), and govern schema evolution. 
 Define ELT/ETL patterns, orchestration strategy, and SLA-backed data freshness 
 commitments. 
 Establish data quality, observability, lineage, and cataloguing practices across the 
 platform. 
 Recommend storage formats, partitioning, and indexing strategies for cost and query 
 performance. 
 3.3 Delivery Leadership 
 •
 Translate business requirements into technical specifications, sprint plans, and 
 implementation roadmaps. 
 •
 •
 Produce HLD, LLD, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for each engagement. 
 Provide hands-on guidance, perform code reviews, and mentor scraping and data 
 engineers. 
 •
 Drive proof-of-concept (PoC) builds for complex or high-risk targets before full-scale 
 rollout. 
 3.4 Compliance, Risk & Governance 
 •
 •
 •
 Ensure all scraping work adheres to applicable laws and platform terms (GDPR, CCPA, 
 DPDP, robots.txt, copyright). 
 Define and enforce ethical scraping practices, request throttling, and PII handling 
 guidelines. 
 Conduct risk assessments for each target source and recommend mitigations. 
 
 
 
 3.5 Performance, Cost & Operations 
 •
 •
 •
 Establish SLAs for crawl freshness, completeness, and accuracy. 
 Design monitoring, alerting, and self-healing mechanisms for scraping pipelines. 
 Optimise infrastructure cost (compute, proxies, storage) without compromising delivery 
 KPIs. 
 4. Required Technical Skills Primary (Web Scraping) 
 These are non-negotiable. The candidate must demonstrate deep, hands-on expertise in 
 each of the following: 
 4.1 Scraping Frameworks & Tooling 
 •
 •
 •
 Expert-level Python: Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, lxml, Requests, httpx, parsel. 
 Headless browser automation: Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, Pyppeteer. 
 Node.js scraping stack (where applicable): Puppeteer, Cheerio, Crawlee. 
 4.2 Anti-Bot & Evasion Strategy 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 Proven experience bypassing Cloudflare, Akamai Bot Manager, DataDome, PerimeterX, 
 Imperva, Kasada. 
 CAPTCHA handling: reCAPTCHA v2/v3, hCaptcha, FunCaptcha, image / audio solvers; 
 integration with 2Captcha, Anti-Captcha, CapSolver. 
 TLS / JA3 / JA4 fingerprinting awareness; HTTP/2 fingerprint evasion; browser fingerprint 
 spoofing. 
 Stealth plugins, user-agent rotation, header normalisation, cookie / session 
 management at scale. 
 4.3 Proxy & Network Infrastructure 
 •
 •
 •
 Hands-on experience with rotating, residential, mobile, ISP, and datacenter proxies. 
 Integration with providers: Bright Data, Oxylabs, Smartproxy, NetNut, IPRoyal, SOAX. 
 Proxy pool design, health-checking, geo-targeting, sticky sessions, and cost optimisation. 
 4.4 Parsing & Extraction 
 •
 •
 •
 XPath, CSS selectors, regex, JSON-LD, microdata, RDFa. 
 Reverse-engineering of internal / mobile APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and XHR traffic. 
 ML/LLM-assisted extraction for unstructured layouts (nice-to-have, increasingly 
 expected). 
 4.5 Distributed Crawling & Orchestration 
 •
 Scrapy-Redis, Scrapy Cluster, Frontera, Crawlee, or equivalent distributed crawling 
 frameworks. 
 •
 •
 Job scheduling and orchestration with Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or Celery. 
 Queue-based architectures using Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, GCP Pub/Sub. 
 5. Required Technical Skills Secondary (Data Engineering) 
 
 
 
 Working-to-strong proficiency expected. The architect must be able to design, review, and 
 guide data engineering work without depending on a separate data architect. 
 5.1 Data Pipelines & Orchestration 
 •
 ETL / ELT design patterns, idempotent pipelines, CDC (Change Data Capture), 
 incremental loads. 
 •
 •
 •
 Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, GCP Dataflow. 
 Stream processing: Kafka Streams, Apache Flink, Spark Structured Streaming. 
 Batch processing: Apache Spark (PySpark), Databricks, EMR, Dataproc. 
 5.2 Data Modelling & Storage 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 Dimensional modelling (Kimball), Data Vault 2.0, normalised vs. denormalised trade-offs. 
 Data warehouses: Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse, Databricks SQL Warehouse. 
 Data lakes / lakehouses: Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi on S3 / GCS / ADLS. 
 OLTP databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL; NoSQL: MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra, 
 Elasticsearch, Redis. 
 •
 File formats: Parquet, Avro, ORC, JSON, CSV; partitioning, bucketing, compaction 
 strategies. 
 5.3 Transformation & Quality 
 •
 •
 •
 dbt (data build tool) for transformation, testing, and documentation. 
 Data quality frameworks: Great Expectations, Soda, Deequ, custom validators. 
 Data lineage and cataloguing: DataHub, OpenMetadata, Amundsen, Atlan, Collibra. 
 5.4 Cloud, DevOps & Observability 
 •
 Strong on at least one of AWS, GCP, Azure (compute, storage, IAM, networking, 
 serverless). 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 Containerisation and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS / GKE / AKS), ECS. 
 Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation. 
 CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Argo CD. 
 Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK / OpenSearch, Datadog, Sentry, 
 OpenTelemetry. 
 6. Experience & Qualifications 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
 10+ years of overall software engineering experience. 
 5+ years dedicated to large-scale web scraping / data extraction (primary). 
 3+ years of hands-on data engineering experience covering pipelines, warehouses / 
 lakehouses, and orchestration (secondary). 
 •
 •
 Proven track record of architecting scraping platforms processing millions of pages per 
 day across diverse target sites. 
 Prior experience as Solution Architect, Tech Lead, or Principal Engineer leading teams of 
 5+ engineers. 
 
 
 
 •
 •
 Demonstrated experience in pre-sales / proposal authoring / RFP responses for scraping 
 or data engineering engagements. 
 Client-facing consulting experience strongly preferred. 
 7. Soft Skills 
 •
 •
 Excellent written and verbal communication; able to defend technical proposals to CXO- 
 level audiences. 
 Strong commercial acumen understands the cost / risk / quality trade-offs in 
 estimation. 
 •
 •
 •
 Analytical, structured problem-solving mindset. 
 Ownership-driven, comfortable being the single point of technical accountability. 
 High standards for documentation, knowledge transfer, and reusability. 
 8. Expected Deliverables (RFP Scope) 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 Technical solution sections of all proposal documents. 
 Target-site feasibility and risk assessment reports. 
 Effort estimation models, assumption logs, and complexity matrices. 
 Solution architecture diagrams and tech stack recommendations for proposals. 
 Delivery Phase 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 •
 •
 •
 High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) documents per initiative. 
 Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). 
 Reference implementations / PoCs for complex extraction scenarios. 
 Code review records and engineering standards documentation. 
 Operational runbooks, monitoring playbooks, and incident response procedures. 
 Compliance and data governance documentation. 
 Knowledge transfer sessions and final handover documentation. 
 9. Nice-to-Have 
 •
 •
 ML / NLP-based extraction, entity resolution, or LLM-assisted parsing experience. 
 Exposure to GraphQL, gRPC, mobile API reverse-engineering, mitmproxy / Charles 
 workflows. 
 •
 Domain experience: e-commerce price intelligence, market research, financial data, real 
 estate, travel aggregation, hospitality. 
 •
 •
 •
 Open-source contributions to scraping or data engineering ecosystems. 
 Familiarity with cross-jurisdictional legal frameworks for automated data collection. 
 Experience with reverse ETL tools (Hightouch, Census) and feature stores.

title: QA QC Engineer
description:
Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Solar QA/QC Engineer with strong hands-on experience in utility-scale MW solar power projects. The candidate will be responsible for Site Execution, Quality Assurance and Quality Control activities for both Electrical and Civil works, ensuring that project execution complies with approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, method statements, ITPs, and applicable codes. The ideal candidate should have practical site experience in Solar PV plant construction, installation, testing and commissioning, with the ability to independently manage QA/QC activities throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities QA/QC General Develop, implement and maintain project-specific QA/QC plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), checklists and quality procedures. Ensure construction activities are carried out as per approved drawings, technical specifications, method statements and applicable standards. Conduct regular site inspections and identify deviations, defects and non-conformities. Prepare and maintain Inspection Requests (IRs), Quality Reports, NCRs, Corrective Action Reports and inspection records. Coordinate with the Engineering, Construction, Procurement, Project Management and Client/Consultant teams for quality-related matters. Monitor subcontractor and vendor compliance with approved quality requirements. Ensure proper documentation and traceability of inspection and testing activities. Conduct quality audits and inspections of ongoing construction activities. Follow up on NCR closure and implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Maintain complete Quality Documentation / Quality Dossier for project handover. Electrical QA/QC Responsibilities Inspect installation of Solar PV modules, module mounting structures, DC cables, AC cables, cable trays, junction boxes, string combiner boxes and inverters. Monitor installation of HT/LT equipment, transformers, RMUs, switchgear, protection systems and auxiliary systems. Inspect DC and AC cable laying, dressing, termination, crimping, glanding and tagging. Verify cable routes, trench construction, cable segregation and installation practices. Inspect earthing and lightning protection systems, including earth pits, earth conductors and equipment earthing. Inspect installation of SCADA, communication and monitoring systems. Verify calibration certificates of testing and measuring instruments. Ensure electrical installations comply with approved SLDs, drawings, specifications and applicable standards. Coordinate with testing & commissioning teams for quality clearance and punch-point closure. Civil QA/QC Responsibilities Inspect site grading, excavation, filling, compaction and land development works. Monitor construction of module mounting structure foundations, inverter foundations, transformer foundations and equipment foundations. Inspect reinforcement, shuttering, anchor bolts, embedded items and concrete works. Verify concrete mix design, batching, pouring, vibration, curing and cube testing. Conduct/coordinate tests such as soil compaction, concrete cube tests and other required material tests. Inspect construction of internal roads, drainage systems, cable trenches, culverts and fencing. Verify survey levels, dimensions and alignment against approved drawings. Ensure civil materials meet approved specifications and quality requirements. Monitor waterproofing, grouting and finishing works wherever applicable. Identify civil defects and ensure timely rectification and closure. Documentation & Reporting Prepare daily, weekly and monthly QA/QC reports. Maintain inspection records, test reports, material inspection reports and calibration certificates. Review Material Test Certificates (MTCs) and relevant quality documents. Maintain approved drawings, method statements, ITPs and checklists at site. Prepare and maintain NCR, observation and punch-point registers. Ensure all quality records are properly compiled for final project handover and as-built documentation. Support client/consultant inspections and audits. Required Qualifications Bachelor's/Diploma degree in Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering or related discipline. 3–5 years of relevant experience in QA/QC, preferably in utility-scale solar PV projects. title: Network Operations Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities We are seeking a highly skilled DDI Network Operations Engineer to manage, maintain, and support enterprise DNS, DHCP, IP Address Management (IPAM), Domain Management, and Certificate Management services across a global environment. The role will be responsible for ensuring the availability, security, performance, and operational excellence of DDI platforms, including Infoblox, UltraDNS, CSC, and associated infrastructure. The engineer will support BAU operations, incident resolution, service requests, platform migrations, and continuous service improvements within a 24x7 operational environment. Key Responsibilities DNS Operations Manage and administer Internal DNS services hosted on Infoblox. Support External/Public DNS services through UltraDNS. Implement and maintain DNS records, zones, forwarding, delegation, and split-DNS architectures. Troubleshoot DNS resolution, latency, and availability issues. Support DNS security controls, including DNS Firewall, malicious domain detection, and threat monitoring. Perform DNS-related changes through approved change management processes. DHCP Operations Administer global DHCP services using Infoblox. Manage DHCP scopes, failover associations, reservations, and lease management. Support DHCP migrations and helper-address modifications. Ensure high availability and redundancy of DHCP infrastructure. Troubleshoot DHCP allocation and connectivity issues. IPAM Operations Manage enterprise IP address allocation and subnet planning. Maintain IPAM as the source of truth for network addressing. Support network segmentation requirements for corporate, guest, vendor, voice, and management networks. Perform IP conflict resolution and capacity management. Assist with cloud network integration and AWS-hosted Infoblox migrations. Domain & Certificate Management Manage domain registrations, renewals, and ownership records through CSC. Support SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle activities including issuance, renewal, and replacement. Monitor certificate expiration and ensure compliance with organizational standards. Coordinate with application and infrastructure teams for certificate deployments. Operations & Service Management Monitor operational dashboards and alerts. Review incidents, requests, change records, and service tasks daily. Resolve tickets within SLA commitments. Participate in shift handovers and operational reviews. Support Incident, Request, Problem, and Change Management processes through ServiceNow. Participate in major incident bridges and restoration activities for critical outages. Security & Compliance Support DNS security monitoring and threat visibility initiatives. Ensure logs are forwarded to enterprise SIEM platforms. Adhere to access management, PAM, MFA, and Zero Trust security controls. Maintain compliance with organizational governance and operational standards. Required Technical Skills Strong experience with Infoblox DNS, DHCP, and IPAM administration. Hands-on experience with UltraDNS or Public DNS Experience with CSC Domain Manager and Certificate Manager. Knowledge of DNS architecture, split-DNS, DNS forwarding, delegation, and DNS security. Understanding of DHCP failover and high-availability designs. Experience with ServiceNow ITSM processes. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or related field. 8+ years of experience in DDI Administration. Experience supporting global enterprise infrastructure environments. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities. Preferred Certifications Infoblox Certified Professional (ICP) CCNA / CCNP AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Networking Specialty Microsoft Azure Administrator ITIL Foundation Certification Key Tools & Platforms Infoblox Grid Manager UltraDNS CSC Domain Manager CSC Certificate Manager ServiceNow Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) Soft Skills Customer-focused mindset. Excellent Communication skills Strong incident management and problem-solving abilities. Ability to work in a global 24x7 support model. Excellent documentation and process adherence. Effective collaboration with network, security, cloud, and infrastructure teams. Experience Level Senior Network Operations Engineer (DDI) | 5-8+ Years Experience

title: Senior / Lead Oracle Exadata Database Administrator
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Job Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Oracle Exadata DBA with deep expertise in Exadata platform administration, RAC, ASM, and Data Guard. The candidate will independently own the database track of a migration program engaging with the customer to gather requirements, documenting current, intermediate, and target-state database environments, and producing HLD/LLD designs for Exadata migrations. 

 Key Responsibilities Exadata Architecture & Administration • Administer and optimize Oracle Exadata Database Machine environments, including compute nodes, storage cells, and InfiniBand/RoCE fabric. • Develop HLD, LLD, and technical architecture documentation for Exadata database environments. 
 • Manage Oracle RAC clusters, Automatic Storage Management (ASM), and Grid Infrastructure. • Design and maintain Data Guard configurations for high availability and disaster recovery. Migration & Requirement Gathering • Capture database migration requirements from the customer, including sizing, downtime windows, and dependencies. • Document current-state database environment (platform, version, size, dependencies, integrations). • Define intermediate and target-state Exadata architecture and migration approach. • Lead database migrations to/from Exadata using RMAN, Data Pump, Oracle GoldenGate, and cross-platform transportable tablespaces. • Develop migration runbooks, cutover plans, validation scripts, and rollback procedures. Platform Operations • Perform Exadata quarterly patching using OEDA/patchmgr, including storage cell, compute node, and InfiniBand switch patching. • Perform performance tuning, SQL optimization, and capacity planning across the Exadata estate. • Manage backup and recovery strategy using RMAN integrated with enterprise backup platforms. Documentation & Leadership • Produce architecture diagrams, SOPs, runbooks, and customer-facing design documentation. • Act as the technical SME for Oracle Exadata technologies; mentor engineers and lead governance reviews. Required Skills • Oracle Database (19c/21c) • Oracle Exadata Database Machine • Oracle RAC & Grid Infrastructure • Automatic Storage Management (ASM) • Oracle Data Guard • RMAN backup & recovery • Oracle GoldenGate • Exadata patching (OEDA, patchmgr) • Oracle Enterprise Manager • Linux administration (Oracle Linux) Preferred Experience 
 • 8+ years of Oracle DBA experience, with L3/L4 Exadata platform expertise. • Proven experience leading database migrations to/from Exadata as part of data center or platform transformation programs. • Experience authoring HLD/LLD and current/intermediate/target-state documentation for customer delivery. 
 Oracle certifications (OCP/OCE Exadata) preferred.

title: AH Mechanical - Reliability Professional
description:
Job Purpose Job Purpose Description Job Context & Major Challenges The Sheet rolling at Belur (very near to Kolkata) was the first plant of Indal to be set up way back in 1943. The initial capacity of the plant was 2500 tons per annum. Over the time, there has been numerous expansion and modernisation and the present capacity of the plant is about 52000 tons per annum. Since the plant is very old, the equipment and the technology are quite outdated except for certain pockets of excellence like SMS Cold Rolling mill. The plant has the usual baggage for outdated practices. But over the last three years there has been significant restructuring and the attitude of the workmen and practices have undergone a sea-change. The strategic direction of the Hindalco Sheet Business is shifting towards more value added as Hindalco is priced out of the common segments. As a result, the value added share for the plant output has seen significant increases. The value added output do not come cheap but calls for substantial changes in workmanship and customer orientation. The plant has been able to meet the challenges. Along with the modernisation in plant and equipment, the business processes in the plant have also been modernised. An ERP system based on Oracle and Orafin has been successfully implemented in the plant. Key Result Areas KRA1 Accountability: Preventive Maintenance: To achieve zero breakdowns by adhering to the maintenance schedule. Tracking the breakdown and to find a trend of the break down in the equipment. To work out Why-Why analysis and find the root cause of a problem. Implement the Kaizen Idea for Continual Improvement. To maximize the P.M Adherence during the preventive maintenance jobs. KRA2 Equipment Reliability: Improving equipment reliability by designing changes in equipments. To implement subtle changes in the design stage of equipment parts to increase the factor of safety and to eliminate the design related defect that lead to breakdown. KRA3 Spares & Cost: Monitor spares and track costs to keep within P&B. Tracking the record of the spares. Monitoring the condition of spare regularly. Control of Hydraulic Oil Consumption and its accessory element. Reduction of Downtime hrs KRA4 Safety & OPEX: Removing unsafe conditions and adhering to OPEX. To adhere with the monthly CO2 Checking. To eliminate the unsafe condition. House Keeping Related jobs. To adhere with 5-S internal auditing. Monitor and eliminate the unsafe acts and conditions for zero accidents and incidents in the Dept. 100% compliance with statutory requirements for Cranes. Ensure safety plans are adhered to as applicable in the department with respective manufacturing group, safety subcommittee. To flow the culture of OPEX in the department. To be a member of Self-maintenance team to implement its standards KRA5 Maintenance - Planning the mechanical maintenance activities of the machines (Like SMS Mill, Bliss cold rolling Mill, Annealing furnaces, Finishing line like Heavy slitters, Heavy Stretcher unit, Old heavy cut to length, all shearing machines) on regular basis to extend the machine life. Effective maintenance planning to optimize machine intervention period. Debottlenecking activities of the mechanical aspects of all key equipments. - Control R&M expenditure to meet the target by monitoring operating costs and ensuring corrective actions as necessary. - Planning , monitoring and controlling spares inventory to improve operating costs. - Initiate proactive measures through periodical audits and condition monitoring of all associated machine centers. KRA6 ISO AND OHSAS SYSTEM: To maintain all the documents of ISO 9PHONE_NUMBER, ISO-14000, OHSAS-18000 for mechanical department. Close and take corrective action for all the NCR s during external or internal audits KRA7 Environment & Energy Management: - Ensure Compliance to ISO 14001. - Ensure Statutory Compliance w.r.t. conditions of Pollution Control Board. - Improve Environmental performance of the Plant through specific projects. - Reduction of Plant Water Consumption and Discharge. To implement in-house developments for energy saving activities KRA8 Projects: - Identify the needs for technology improvement and acquiring new assets through knowledge up gradation and interactions. - Planning and monitoring of capex projects within budgeted time and cost meeting targeted deliverables. To improve power productivity of the plant, implement the energy saving projects KRA9 HRD Activities: To educate, motivate and involve employees in the department in fulfillment of departmental objectives, prepare annual training plan. Maintain the administration of the Mechanical Maintenance department and control the overtime below the target
